name: Ip2_CohFrictMat_CohFrictMat_CohFrictPhys
description:
Generates cohesive-frictional interactions with moments, used in the contact law Law2_ScGeom6D_CohFrictPhys_CohesionMoment. The normal/shear stiffness and friction definitions are the same as in Ip2_FrictMat_FrictMat_FrictPhys, check the documentation there for details.

attributes.name: setCohesionNow
attributes.description: If true, assign cohesion to all existing contacts in current time-step. The flag is turned false automatically, so that assignment is done in the current timestep only.

attributes.name: setCohesionOnNewContacts
attributes.description: If true, assign cohesion at all new contacts. If false, only existing contacts can be cohesive (also see

attributes.name: normalCohesion
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining tensile strength

attributes.name: shearCohesion
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining cohesive part of the shear strength (a frictional term might be added depending on cohesionDisablesFriction)

attributes.name: rollingCohesion
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining cohesive part of the rolling strength (a frictional term might be added depending on cohesionDisablesFriction). The default is $ frac{r}{4}R_t$ with $R_t$ the shear strength (inspired by stress in beams with circular cross-section).

attributes.name: twistingCohesion
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining cohesive part of the twisting strength (a frictional term might be added depending on cohesionDisablesFriction). The default is $ frac{r}{2}R_s$ with $R_s$ the shear strength (inspired by stress in beams with circular cross-section).

attributes.name: frictAngle
attributes.description: Instance of MatchMaker determining how to compute interaction's friction angle. If None, minimum value is used.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.

methods.name: setCohesion
methods.description: Bond or un-bond an interaction with cohesion. When True, the resulting state is the same as what is obtained by executing an InteractionLoop with the functor's setCohesionNow or the interaction's initCohesion True. It will use the matchmakers if defined. The only difference is that calling this function explicitly will make the contact cohesive even if not both materials have isCohesive=True. When False, the resulting state is the same as after breaking a fragile interaction. If `resetDisp` is True, the current distance is taken as the reference for computing normal displacement and normal force.
